brief:
James "Fergie" Chambers, a pro-Palestine philanthropist, faced an extradition hearing in Spain as the United States pursues charges against him, Al Jazeera English reported. Chambers has denied wrongdoing in connection with the case. His wife has appealed to Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez to grant him political asylum.

The hearing represents an escalating legal battle over Chambers's status and the allegations facing him in the United States.
dek: James 'Fergie' Chambers denies wrongdoing, while his wife urges PM Sanchez to grant him political asylum.
title: US seeks extradition of pro-Palestine philanthropist from Spain
